root.label: Poste sweetens Telecom Italia takeover offer

events.label: Poste sweetens Telecom Italia takeover offer

slots.name: Poste stake
slots.sentence: Poste, which had previously built a 20% stake in TIM, launched its bid earlier this year as part of a plan to create a national champion in digital infrastructure and services.

slots.name: shares secured
slots.sentence: Reuters calculations based on stock exchange data showing Poste had so far secured only an additional 5% of TIM's share capital through the offer.

slots.name: exchange ratio
slots.unit: newly issued Poste shares per TIM share
slots.sentence: That prompted state-controlled Poste to increase the cash component of its offer late on Monday by 18% to €1.97 per share, while confirming an exchange ratio of 0.218 newly issued Poste shares for each TIM share tendered.

slots.name: offer valuation
slots.sentence: The revised terms value the offer at €13.15 billion ($15.29 billion) at current market prices, around €550 million more than the previous bid.

slots.name: annual benefits
slots.sentence: The state-backed conglomerate, which projected annual pre-tax benefits of €700 million from the deal, also waived the 66.67% acceptance threshold it had initially set as a condition for the offer to proceed.

slots.name: initial offer value
slots.sentence: At Monday's close, TIM shares were trading at €7.42, implying a premium to the €7.39 value of Poste's initial offer.

slots.name: cash offer price

slots.name: board approval date
slots.sentence: TIM's board of directors unanimously backed the Poste offer in July.

slots.name: offer period reopening
slots.sentence: It said the offer period would reopen from September 21 to September 25.

slots.name: offer premium per share
slots.sentence: TIM shares rose 2.5% to €7.66 by 0830 GMT, with Poste's offer representing a premium of about two euro cents per share.
